task.action: Add the late order, then mark it packed once

new_order_dialog.name: add-order-desktop
new_order_dialog.accessibility_snapshot_text:
- region "Notifications alt+T"
- main:
  - text: No orders yet Add your first order and it'll show up here, sorted by what needs attention.
  - button "Add an order"
- dialog "Add an order":
  - heading "Add an order" [level=2]
  - paragraph: It'll show up on the board, sorted by due date.
  - text: Customer
  - textbox "Customer":
    - /placeholder: e.g. Priya Shah
    - text: R01 Bakery Customer
  - text: Order
  - textbox "Order":
    - /placeholder: e.g. 2 dozen chocolate chip cookies
    - text: 2 dozen rolls
  - text: Due date
  - textbox "Due date": 2026-10-08
  - text: Notes (optional)
  - textbox "Notes (optional)":
    - /placeholder: e.g. nut allergy, pickup after 2pm
    - text: Synthetic R01 UI test
  - button "Add order"
  - button "Close"

before_packed.name: before-packed-desktop
before_packed.accessibility_snapshot_text:
- region "Notifications alt+T"
- banner:
  - text: Order Board.
  - button "New order"
- main:
  - heading "Today's orders" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Late and unpacked orders surface first, so you always know what to grab next.
  - paragraph: Needs attention
  - text: 1 order late and unpacked
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Customer Order Due Status Packed":
        - columnheader "Customer"
        - columnheader "Order"
        - columnheader "Due"
        - columnheader "Status"
        - columnheader "Packed"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "R01 Bakery Customer 2 dozen rolls Synthetic R01 UI test Invalid Date Late Mark packed":
        - cell "R01 Bakery Customer"
        - cell "2 dozen rolls Synthetic R01 UI test"
        - cell "Invalid Date"
        - cell "Late"
        - cell "Mark packed":
